evidence_items.explanation: The experiments show performance gains from additional inference computation within an LLM approach. This challenges dismissing resources as irrelevant, but does not establish a binding industry-wide shortage in early 2026.

The paper studies small recursive networks and reports advantages on particular puzzle benchmarks. It supports taking alternatives seriously, but does not show that reallocating industry effort away from LLMs would improve AI progress generally.

unresolved_gaps: No identified study isolates the industry-wide effect of concentrating research on LLMs against the listed competing constraints.
The evidence does not establish that access, talent, resources, novel approaches, and industry support were all nonbinding in the target period.
Results on particular benchmarks do not determine the counterfactual pace of broadly useful AI development.
